slides.body: Rainfall is coming and your company has abandoned you. Flooding will be frequent.

slides.header: Survive the Tide IV - Blue vs. Red
slides.body: Stick with your team. Your survival depends on it.

slides.header: Survive the Tide IV - Loot Pipes
slides.body: Chests are rare. Pipes with loot droppers aren't. If your team wants gear, they'll be how you get it.

slides.header: Survive the Tide IV - Big Red Buttons
slides.body: Near every loot dropper is a button to start it. But you'll need enough of your teammates nearby to activate them.
In 15 minutes an extraction zone will open at the ravines highest level. Your entire team must claim it to win.
